impact: Promise.all means a single lens failure returns error for the whole analysis rather than partial results. Acceptable for Phase 1 — partial results with failed lenses would be confusing.
resolution: Switched from Promise.all to Promise.allSettled in zug_reasoning_analysis. Individual lens failures now produce a (lens failed) placeholder for that lens instead of failing the entire call. Partial results are returned for all 6 lenses even if some error.
title: [ux] Promise.all means a single lens failure returns error for the whole analysis rat
